name: RDYC B5: wind north-east (club course)
description: Start at H Ls 3s 1s [Hs] 1s finish at H. 5.1 NM; shortened course 3.6 NM, finishing at Homestone (H). Course Group B: normal inshore courses with a committee boat, the shorter ones for Classes 2 and 3 (Squibs are Class 3, SI 5.2). Shorten course and lap times are not simulated.

provenance.notes: Mark positions are the club's approximate positions. The committee boat's position is not in the document: the simulator places her (see the CB mark). marks.name: Committee boat
marks.source: Course Appendix 3: the line runs between the committee boat's orange-flag staff and the course side of the ODM. Where she anchors is the race officer's choice on the day: the simulator places her square to the wind at the ODM, the line long enough for the fleet, in the deeper water (E).
